line.comment: * This script is the authoritative owner for global balance and tuning variables formerly defined in the 9972 t-file.
* Add-Ons 2.2: Most variables have been removed from the config file to prevent exploits. See version history on GitHub for old t-file information.
* Research cycle time. This variable is used for both Cyberwar Center and Research Stations.
* Time and build dividers were made constant since ZH.
* Also the baseline timer for Xenon garrisons (1-3 hours per garrison) and the grace period for the first Xenon invasion fleet.
* Note: See Mayhem.Init.Variables for Pirate Base cap. Fixed Pirate limit has been deprecated in favor of dynamic limit.
* Add-Ons 2.1.1: Outpost consumption cycle is now fixed at 10 minutes.
* How much work is needed to increase specialization by 1%.
* Natural growth is now handled solely in Mayhem.GetNaturalGrowth (always 9).
* Food production per person at each cycle.
* Food consumption per person at each cycle.
* Every X people, increase negative event chance by 1%.
* How many spaceweed to produce per cycle. Scales with infamy.
* ALL bailed ships respect this cap.
* Fleet ratio per X sectors owned.
* Only station debt is enabled, allowing the AI to defer station resource costs.
* Shared resources across Outposts and allies.
* AI score: 1 point per sector + 1 point per 270 pops + 1 point per 30 stations. If less than or equal to this score, all crafting is free.
* Player cheat: if set to 1, removes docking restrictions. Disabled to prevent the player from docking at Outposts unless the player is trading.
* Station repair and ship repair while docked at Outposts.
* Base carrier repair rate is 10% of station and Outpost hull repair.
* Add-Ons 2.2: The coalition system is always enabled and no longer has a configuration variable.
* Favor Point cost in credits. This is unused but still in the GUI code. Increased cost: 100k -> 1M in case it's used in the future.
* Favor Point cost in Loyalty Points.
* Percentage of the galaxy for the Yaki to conquer upon arrival.
* Difference in empire size as a percentage.
* Multipliers and illegal cargo scan have been deprecated.
* M7M and M8 do not respect this threshold. Other ships check if target shields are below this threshold before they fire missiles.
* Number of incoming missiles to target.
* The AI checks if it can build at least 2 ships before accepting the player's order.
* Costs 20% more to buy ships from a faction than making your own.
* Defense cost is calculated two ways: one in credits, one in Red Crystals (costs 50% more; used only when aligned with the OCV)
